name: fixture-permissions
instructions: Observe the fixture mode. Restore the owner-selected mode on confirmed drift, then check again.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN json_extract(:input,'$.observed') IS NULL THEN json_object('status','unknown') WHEN json_extract(:input,'$.observed')=json_extract(:input,'$.expected') THEN json_object('status','healthy') ELSE json_object('status','drifted','mode',json_extract(:input,'$.expected')) END
